description: FREE, verify-only check that your x402 client can pay URLGate before you spend anything. Call without payment → isError result with a two-leg PaymentRequired (main accepts[] entry + extensions["platform-fee"] entry; tiny amounts, 30 s validBefore). Sign BOTH with the same wallet and call again with _meta["x402/payment"] + _meta["x402/payment-fee"] (or paymentSignature + paymentSignatureFee). Both legs are verified, NEVER settled; you get verdict ok | fee_leg_missing | main_leg_missing | wrong_network | bad_signature | amount_mismatch (or requirement_mismatch, payer_mismatch, expired, insufficient_funds, facilitator_unavailable). Signatures sent here can never pay for anything. The preview testnet test link REQUIRES a wallet with Base Sepolia testnet + test USDC. If your wallet can't use testnet, follow the production path: run payment_compat_check on production (verify-only, no funds move) and, if you meet the two-signature requirements, proceed with the real paid tools. Testnet path: 1. wallet on Base Sepolia with test USDC; 2. payment_compat_check on the preview deployment; 3. sign both legs, call again; 4. verdict ok = ready. Production path: 1. payment_compat_check on production (verify-only, no funds move); 2. sign both legs, call again; 3. verdict ok = proceed with the real paid tools.

paymentSignature.description: MAIN leg: base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload for an accepts[] entry (same as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Fallback for params._meta["x402/payment"], which wins when both are sent. Omit on the first call to get the payment requirements.

paymentSignatureFee.description: FEE leg (open_link only, REQUIRED when the requirements have extensions["platform-fee"]): base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload for the extensions["platform-fee"].accepts[] entry on the same network, signed by the same wallet (same as PAYMENT-SIGNATURE-FEE). Fallback for params._meta["x402/payment-fee"]. Without it the call is refused with fee_leg_missing and nothing is charged. Sent ALONE when a partial payment owes only the platform fee (code partial_payment).

name: payment_compat_check
title: Payment compatibility check (free, verify-only)
